metadata.description: Marketplace for the Comprehension Gate plugin: hooks that ask a coding agent to record what a change was for, where it was more than mechanical, and name the record when the path is read or edited

plugins.name: comprehension-gate
plugins.description: Have the coding agent record what it changed and why — docstrings on the code, an immutable note for any change that is more than mechanical — and name a path's notes as it is read or edited
